title: Link
description: Directed relation between two nodes, produced by one or more extractors during a scan.

target.description: `node.path` of the destination. MAY point to a missing node; analyzers detect broken refs.

kind.description: Nature of the relation. `invokes` = execution-level call (e.g. slash command). `references` = explicit link (e.g. wikilink, @-directive). `mentions` = informal textual mention. `supersedes` = replaces another node (from `metadata.supersedes`).

confidence.description: Extractor's self-assessed confidence `[0..1]`. Drives UI edge opacity (more confident = more opaque). Migrated from the legacy string union `'high' | 'medium' | 'low'` to a numeric range so callers can express finer granularity than three buckets. Reference scoring: `1.0` = structured input (sidecar annotation), `0.95` = unambiguous syntax (`[text](file.md)`), `0.85` = strong signal with one inference (`@file.md`), `0.5` = genuine ambiguity (`@bare-handle`). The named tiers `HIGH = 0.9`, `MEDIUM = 0.6`, `LOW = 0.3` are exposed on the kernel side as the `ConfidenceTier` constants for callers that want to think in buckets. Analyzers MAY filter by confidence threshold.

sources.description: Extractor ids that produced this link. At least one. Multiple extractors may converge on the same link; kernel merges them.

trigger.description: Trigger-style link metadata (e.g. slash-command keyword, @-directive keyword). Null for links without a textual trigger.

originalTrigger.description: Exact string as it appears in the source body.

normalizedTrigger.description: NFD → strip diacritics → lowercase → hyphen/underscore → space → collapse whitespace → trim. Used for collision detection and lookup.

location.description: Where in the source body the link was found. Null if the extractor didn't track location.

raw.description: Verbatim matched substring from the source body. Optional, for debugging and UI display.
